questions.content: Among PbS, CuS, HgS, MnS, Ag<sub>2</sub>S, NiS, CoS, Bi<sub>2</sub>S<sub>3</sub> and SnS<sub>2</sub> the total number of black coloured sulphides is
questions.explanation:
(i) Lead in +2 oxidation state as reacts with hydrogen sulphide gas to form black coloured precipitate of lead sulphide .

(ii) Silver in +1 oxidation state as reacts with hydrogen sulphide in neutral or acidic medium to form black coloured precipitate of silver sulphide .

(Black ppt)

is black coloured precipitate.

(iii) Mercury in +2 oxidation state as reacts with hydrogen sulphide in dilute hydrochloric acid to form black coloured precipitate of mercury sulphide (HgS).

HgS is black coloured precipitate.

(iv) Copper in +2 oxidation state as reacts with dilute hydrochloric acid to form black coloured precipitate of copper sulphide (CuS).

CuS is black coloured precipitate.

(v) Cobalt in +2 oxidation state as reacts with hydrogen sulphide in neutral or alkaline solution to form black coloured precipitate of cobalt sulphide.

is black coloured precipitate.

(vi) Nickel in +2 oxidation state as reacts with hydrogen sulphide in neutral or slightly alkaline solution to form, black coloured precipitate of nickel sulphide.

NiS is black coloured precipitate.

(vii) Bismuth in +3 oxidation state as reacts with hydrogen sulphide in cold dilute hydrochloric acid to form crystalline dark brown coloured precipitate, but appears black coloured solid of .

may appear black in colours.

Either compounds of sulphur are black in colour.

(viii) In mildly acidic, medium tin in +2 state, i.e., reacts with Hydrogen sulphide to form brown coloured tin (II) sulphide which further reacts with excess of hydrogen sulphide to form light yellow coloured tin (IV) sulphide .

Hence, tin (IV) sulphide or is yellow in colour.

(ix) MnS is known to be dirty pink coloured.
